tei:div.tei:p: gcod lugs nyer mkho changs bu brgya rtsa'i phyag len khrigs chags su bkod pa bzhugs so// na mo pradzñā pā ra mi ta ye/ yum chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// changs bu brgya rtsa'i 'don 'grigs bkod pa la// dgongs pas khrol la bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs// de la dang po nad pa'i lus bkrus pa'i changs bu brgya rtsa brgyad byas la/ de la sha dum lhan/ snod gcig tu nad pa'i khrus chu bzhag la/ de nas gcod tshogs yin na bstab pa'i skabs bya/ 'phral du yin na lus sbyin dkar 'gyed mang zhig gi mthar/ phaṭa/ skad cig gis stong gsum 'di o rgyan rang byung gi dur khrod du gyur pa'i dbus su/ rang nyid rig pa'i ngo bo ma cig khros ma nag mo phyag g.yas mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rdeb pas snang srid dbang du sdud pa/ g.yon mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud pas srid gsum zil gyis gnon cing khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i skur gyur/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ma cig lab kyi sgron ma sku mdog dkar mo dar dkar gyi ral ga gsol ba/ dbu skra sil mas sku rgyab khebs pa/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de la ma cig rigs lnga la sogs gcod yul brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ de'i mtha' skor du nad pa 'di'i lus gdon gnas gdon/ nad nad bdag dang bcas pa/ gdon sna 'dren dang bcas pa/ bgegs rigs lan chags sha 'khon yul 'dre dang bcas pa sa gzhi gang nas 'khod par gyur/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ nad pa'i snying gar rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo āḥdakar po gsal ba dbu ma'i lam nas thon/ rang nyid khros ma'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ na mo/ grub thob gcod yul brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ yi dam khros ma nag mo'i bden pa dang*/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma rigs lnga'i bden pa dang*/

rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus/ nad pa 'di la dang po nad kyi sna 'dren pa/ bar du nad kyi tshang bca' ba/ tha ma nad la mi phan par byed pa/ tshe la rku ba/ srog la 'jab pa/ yid la rlom pa/ bla la 'khyer bar byed pa'i lus gdon rgyab brten dang bcas pa/ nad nad bdag dang bcas pa/ gdon sna 'dren dang bcas pa thams cad nad pa'i bem po dang dbyer med pa'i dri chu changs bu sha dum khrus chu dang bcas pa 'di rnams la khug cig /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ rkang gling 'bud/ ḍā dril drag tu bya/ phaṭa/ nad pa'i bem po dang dbyer med pa'i dri chu changs bu sha dum 'di nyid ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la/ rnam pa nad pa dngos dang 'dra ba/ dngos las lhag pa/ phung khams skye mched tshang ba re re la'ang brgya stong grangs med pa 'phro ba 'di nyid ma cig rigs lnga mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas pa phyogs bcu'i lha 'dre 'byung po lan chags kyi bdag po bdag mo thams cad la sbyin no// 'bul lo// bsngo'o/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ mnyes shing tshims nas 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i lan chags sha 'khon thams cad byang nas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ de nas khyim du yin na phud skyogs kyi nang du changs bu sha dum khrus chus bran nas/ mchod g.yog pas bzung la/ phaṭ/ bem po lus gdon dbyer med pa'i// sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i zhal du bstab// bzhes shig rol cig lus gdon phrol// glud zan dri khu'i rgya mtsho 'di// lhan cig skyes pa'i bdud rnams dang*// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*// byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dang*// pho mo nad bdag rims yams bdag /gre bo gre mo the'u rang 'gong*// lan chags bdag po thams cad la// dgos 'dod mkho dgur gyur nas kyang*// zad med longs spyod thob gyur cig

/phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas khrus chu changs bu snod gcig tu gsog /de ltar lan brgya rtsa brgyad song nas/ phaṭa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ma cig 'ja' ltar yal/ rang dang bsrung bya'i sems dang ma cig thugs// dbyer med chos dbyings nam mkha'i ngang du thim// skye med yum chen dgongs pa mngon gyur cig /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas khrus chu changs bu dur khrod gcig tu gtor/ gnyan sa yin na 'phral du phyogs phyogs gtor/ de yang mtha' gtad spur gzugs bsreg pa dang*/ me'i mtha' gtad sogs la changs bu brgya rtsa dgos pas de nyid changs bu brgya rtsa yin par 'dod pa mi 'thad do// gnyan chen mtha' gtad me chu mtha' gtad 'byung bzhi'i gzer bu dang bzhi ni mtha' gtad yin/ tshogs kyi bstab pa drag po dang*/ cha drug dang*/ changs bu brgya rtsa rnam gsum ni bstab pa yin la/ de yang rang re'i na tsha sdug bsngal/ sngon gyi lan chags sha 'khon byang zhing lha 'dre'i 'khu ldog zhi/ gnyan sar rung zhing phan yon che// zur mang lugs kyi dmigs 'bum chen mo na/ 'di yi rtsa ba yod kyang*/ phyag len gyi brgyud 'dra min mang po 'dug cing*/ 'don cha gsal po ma byung nas/ 'phral dgos zhig gi ched du/ dge slong rā ga a s+yes bsgrigs pa nyes 'gal mchis na/ ma cig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ dge bas 'gro phan rgya chen 'byung bar shog /maṅga laṃ/// /
